resources.string: Speak now. The words appear here as you talk.
To turn what you say into text, Plan-B needs the microphone while you dictate. Your phone\'s speech service recognizes the words; Plan-B keeps no recording.
Microphone access is off for Plan-B. To dictate, turn it on in the app\'s settings under Permissions › Microphone.
This phone has no speech recognition service turned on. Install or enable one (such as Speech Services by Google), add the Persian language for use without the internet, then try again.
Nothing was understood. Try again and speak a little closer to the phone.
The speech service could not be reached. Check your internet connection, or add the language for offline use in the phone\'s voice settings.
The speech service is busy. Try again in a moment.
The speech service doesn\'t have this language yet. Add it in the phone\'s voice settings, then try again.
